Name: Dwarven Expansion - Animal Husbandry Patch
Author: mytigio
Description:
Adds compatibility for Animal Husbandry to Dwarven Expansion.

Requires:
Animal Husbandry (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538)
Dwarven Expansion (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021)


Grubs drop a large quantity of Bug Meat when butchered.
Grubs accept Slime, Green Algae, White Algae and Weeds as treats.

Crabs drop a single crab when butchered.
Crabs accept Bug Meat, grub larva, wild bait and deluxe bait as treats.

Molerats drop a new item, Molerat Meat when butchered.
Molerats accept cave carrots as treats.

Badgers drop a new item, Badger Meat when butchered.
Badgers accept bug meat, grub larva, chicken, salamander meat and crabs as treats.

Giant Pale Salamanders drop a new item, Salamander Meat when butchered.
Salamanders accept bug meat, grub larva, wild bait and deluxe bait as treats.

If you have Evaria's Dragons Expanded the dragons will now accept treats as well, Dragons will accept Salamander Meat, Badger Meat, Molerat Meat, Beef and Mutton as treats.
